name: SaMD
description: Software intended for a medical purpose without being part of a hardware medical device. PinnacleAI® GPT-OS is listed as Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support software in the supplied MD-5.

name: MD-3
description: The application submitted for a licence to manufacture Class A or Class B medical devices. An application is a step in the regulatory record; it is not the issued licence.

name: MD-5
description: The issued licence records the named manufacturer, premises, device and intended use. Pinnacle’s supplied MD-5 names PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 for non-diagnostic developmental support, ages 0–12.

name: BIS scope
expanded: Bureau of Indian Standards licence and scope schedule
description: The reviewed BIS record describes the management system and activities within its named scope, including developmental-support software modules. It does not establish every centre’s registration or guarantee clinical outcomes.

name: HFR
description: The Health Facility Registry assigns facility identifiers. On 19 September 2026, 56 complete IDs were matched in the authenticated NHPR dashboard; 33 displayed Approved. Other workflow statuses and one masked Draft are shown separately. A directory match is not a finding about current operations, clinical quality or outcomes.

name: UDIN
description: An identifier for a practitioner’s document. Both supplied UDINs were matched in the live ICAI portal on 19 September 2026 and showed Active. A UDIN authenticates registered particulars; it does not extend the report’s scope.

name: SAE 3000
expanded: Limited-assurance report in this evidence collection
description: The supplied practitioner report gives limited assurance over specified institutional assertions and counting criteria. Read its dated thresholds and scope; it does not validate every headline statistic or a child’s clinical outcome.

name: SRS 4400
description: The supplied report records procedures and findings for defined institutional counts. It does not provide an assurance opinion. Its observed counts and the SAE 3000 assertion floors have different reporting roles.

name: ICD-11
description: World Health Organization. A common classification and clinical terminology for recording, comparing and aggregating health information. It gives health-related records a consistent reference language. Pinnacle’s dossier describes ICD-11 reference alignment; this does not make the software diagnostic.

name: ICF
expanded: International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health
description: World Health Organization. A framework covering body functions and structures, activities, participation and environmental context. It helps keep daily life and the support needed to participate in view. Pinnacle’s handout and dossier describe ICF mappings. The dossier’s b-code examples describe body functions; activity, participation and environment need their own relevant codes.

name: ICHI
description: World Health Organization. A classification for recording and analysing health interventions through their target, action and means. It can help describe what intervention is delivered in a consistent way. Pinnacle’s dossier describes ICHI intervention coding within its architecture.

name: SNOMED CT
description: SNOMED International. A detailed clinical terminology that represents information through concepts, descriptions and relationships. It supports consistent meaning in electronic clinical records. Pinnacle’s dossier describes SNOMED CT terminology alignment. SNOMED International is the responsible organisation.
